subject: english
question:
Choose the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

Russia uses the prospect of a gas cutoff to put pressure on Kiev and __compel__ Europe.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"compel"** means to force or drive someone to do something. (मजबूर करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The weather **compelled **us to stay indoors.
 
 
 
• **"Coerce"** refers to persuading an unwilling person to do something by using force or threats. (दबाव डालना)
 
 
• **Example:** The kidnappers **coerced** the victim to call their family for ransom.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'compel'** is **'coerce'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Discourage** (हतोत्साहित करना): To cause someone to lose confidence or enthusiasm.

 
 
• **Example:** His failure did not discourage him from trying again.
 
 
 
• **Dissuade** (रोकना): To persuade someone not to take a particular course of action.
 
 
• **Example:** They tried to dissuade her from leaving the job.
 
 
 
• **Assist** (सहायता करना): To help or aid someone.
 
 
• **Example:** The nurse assisted the doctor during the operation.
 
 

34:Tb99,

The correct answer is: **Option 2**.
